physicalNotes: Radius 0.17129122 Jupiter radii from Crossfield et al. 2025 (2025AJ....169...89C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract): 12,246 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.02831717 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
